query:
UPDATE intakeSubmissions
SET
  keyChallenges = 'Udder solves three distinct problems for TA leaders:

1. CONSULTING — Independent technology guidance before vendor selection. Best for organisations that have not yet selected a TA or HR technology platform. Client signals: "We need to replace our ATS", "Our recruitment tech isn''t fit for purpose", "We want to consolidate our TA tech stack", "We need help building a business case for new hiring technology", "We''re not sure which recruitment platform is right for us", "We want an independent view of the market before we commit." Udder maps current-state recruitment and onboarding processes, identifies gaps, defines requirements, and runs independent vendor selection across ATS, CRM, onboarding, workforce management, and adjacent tools.

2. IMPLEMENTATION — Expert deployment of already-selected TA or HR technology. Best for organisations that have chosen a platform but lack internal resource to deploy it, or are struggling to get value from a live system. Client signals: "We''ve chosen a system but don''t have the internal resource to implement it", "Our ATS implementation stalled or went badly", "Recruiters aren''t using the system properly", "We''re not getting the value we expected from our TA tech", "We need ongoing admin support for our ATS or HRIS", "We want to use AI features in our recruitment platform but don''t know where to start." Udder delivers end-to-end deployment including project governance, system configuration, data migration, integrations, training, and go-live. Post-launch Assist and AI Augment services available.

3. TECHNICAL CONSULTING — Specialist technical expertise for complex TA/HR technology ecosystems. Client signals: "Our recruitment systems don''t integrate properly", "We''ve had a data or security concern related to candidate information", "We''re not sure our ATS setup will scale as we grow", "We need a technical review before a major system change", "We need help with GDPR compliance around how we store and process candidate data." Services include Integration Consulting, Tech Healthchecks, and CISO Consulting specific to HR and talent technology.',
  companyBoilerplate = 'Udder is an independent Talent Acquisition technology consultancy helping recruitment leaders make smarter, faster tech decisions and turn them into decisive action under pressure. We are not aligned to any vendor — our recommendations are based solely on client needs.

Our three practice areas cover the full TA technology lifecycle:

- Consulting: Independent guidance for organisations evaluating, rationalising, or planning investment in recruitment and people technology. We run structured discovery, define requirements, and lead independent vendor selection across ATS, CRM, onboarding, workforce management, and adjacent tools.

- Implementation: End-to-end deployment of TA and HR technology platforms, including project governance, system configuration, data migration, integrations, training, and go-live. Our Assist service provides ongoing optimisation support; our AI Augment service helps organisations activate AI capabilities within their existing platforms.

- Technical Consulting: Specialist expertise in TA/HR technology infrastructure, including Integration Consulting, Tech Healthchecks, and CISO Consulting (data security, GDPR compliance, candidate data risk).

Many of our team are ex-TA leaders. We blend deep recruitment expertise with technical delivery capability so your stack supports the way your business actually attracts, engages, and hires talent.'
WHERE sponsorId = 360001;
